title: NearbyHandshakeCommitment v2
description: First message on the wire (recipient to origin). Lenient decoder; unknown keys ignored. helloDigest commits to the projection {version, role, ephemeralPublicKey} of the recipient hello - advisory fields stay out of the projection. Frozen for protocol version 2.

helloDigest.description: base64, SHA-256 over the committed hello projection

appVersion.description: Advisory: sender's CFBundleShortVersionString; sanitize before display

supportedVersions.description: Advisory: lets a future origin downgrade to an old recipient before disclosing anything
